players.name: Austin Greer
players.bio: Co-founder of Toasty FC, Austin is much more than the captian of the team - he's also the social media manager, stat tracker, video editor, website builder, and more! This club has become more than just a futsal team to him. It's a combination of hobbies and skills coalescing together into one passion project. Plus at the end of the day he still get's to enjoy playing soccer with his friends on the week!

seasons.name: 2022 Winter - BG Futsal
seasons.overview: In their inaugural season Toasty FC joined the B Division of BG Futsal League. Equipped with a full roster, and the most clever team name in the league, Toasty would end up finishing 3rd during the regular season qualifying for their first playoff appearance.

seasons.name: 2023 Spring - BG Futsal
seasons.overview: In their second season Toasty FC made itself known as a serious B Division contender. A couple new faces made debuts this season as well in: Mahmood "Mo" Alalawi [Midfielder] & Duncan McKenzie [Defender]. After finishing the regular season in 4th place, a fantastic playoff run lead Toasty FC to its first ever DIVISION B CHAMPIONSHIP!

seasons.name: 2023 Winter - BG Futsal
seasons.overview: Returning as Division B Champions, Toasty FC looked to continue their winning ways despite dropping 4 players. However, 2 new recruits joined the fray in: Jake Martin [Defender // Goalkeeper] & Dan Williams [seasoned Midfielder]. Finishing the regular season again in 4th place, Toasty FC would make it's 3rd straight playoff appearance.

seasons.name: 2024 Spring - BG Futsal
seasons.overview: Toasty FC returned from holiday break with 3 new players rostering a full 12 man squad: "Mo" Alalawi [Midfielder] made a seasonal return, Dylan Goad [Midfielder], & Murdy [Midfielder]. While the season started off rough, Toasty FC made a strong regular season comeback to again finish in 4th place for the third season in a row. This would lead to Toasty's 4th consecutive playoff appearance.

seasons.name: 2024 Summer - 3v3 Live
seasons.overview: Looking to fill the off-season down time, the Toasty boys took their first foray into organized tournament play outside the BG Futsal League. This nationally organized tournament series features fast-paced, small-sided 3v3 games with no goalkeeper with tournaments across the country.

seasons.name: 2024 Winter - BG Futsal
seasons.overview: Toasty FC had 3 new faces join for this winter season: Cory House [Defender], Henry Mendez [Midfielder], & Alim Mirzayev [Midfielder]. BG Futsal also expanded to 26 teams - the most in League history! With 14 teams facing off again in the B Division, and only 9 games promised, every point counts as not all teams will be faced. This proved to be Toasty FC's best regular season yet finishing in 2nd overall during the regular season!

seasons.name: 2025 Spring - BG Futsal
seasons.overview: PROMOTED! Toasty FC got the bump up to the A Division. New challenges require new talent, and Toasty FC were lucky to add a solid player: A.J. Ray [Midfielder] this season. All 12 guys would need to bring their best this season as the A Division hosts some of the best players in the city.

seasons.name: 2025 Summer - 3v3 Live
seasons.overview: Returning to the 3v3 Live tournament Toasty FC took home 3rd place out of 5 teams in the Adult division. Due to the heat, the camera equipment was overheating so these games were not recorded.

seasons.name: 2025 Winter - BG Futsal
seasons.overview: The Toasty boys return to the A Division to improve upon their last outing. NOT LAST is the goal!

news.title: 2025 Winter Players Needed!
news.summary: A stunning 3-1 performance propels Toasty FC to the top of the summer league standings.
news.content: With some recent departures from the squad Toasty FC is looking to fill in some gaps in the lineup! Think you have the skills? Contact us today to become part of the legacy!

news.title: 2025 3v3 Live
news.summary: Toasty FC will be playing in the Adult division of the 2025 3v3 Live Tournament in Bowling Green, KY.
news.content: We'll be @3v3 Live in Bowling Green! After finishing 2nd in last years Adult division, the boys hope to improve this year and take home the gold!

news.title: 2025 Winter Season begins soon!

news.content: The wait is almost over! 2025 Season reservations started today and filled up fast. Toasty FC have decided to give the A Division another shot and improve upon last years result. Stay tuned for more on the upcoming season.
